2024_general.fact: Wayback: www.harrisvotes.com/Election-Results/Live-Results captured 2024-11-05 20:39 CST embeds '<iframe src="https://app.harrisvotes.com/electionresults/electionday">', but the app page capture (20:39:21 CST) failed to download ('URLError: timed out'), so its precinct view code was not saved; the saved resultsbyballot.json (dt 2024-11-06T01:10:00Z) holds county contest totals only. Not settled by check 3. No Clarity; county report files not checked within budget.

2026_primary.fact: Wayback capture of app.harrisvotes.com/ElectionResults/RepublicanPrimary at 2026-03-03 20:01:30 CST: each contest has a tab '<a href="#precinctVoting-{{ contest.i }}" ...title="Precinct Reporting">' whose GetPrecinctVotesData calls "$http.get('https://appfiles.harrisvotes.com/harrisvotes/prd/Data/' + electionCode + '/rep-pv-' + contestId + '.json?nocache=' + cacheTime)", the same feed and cache-busting time ('var cacheTime = (new Date(new Date().setSeconds(0, 0))).getTime();') as the county totals ('/rep-resultsbyballot.json?nocache=' + cacheTime). RenderPrecinctVoting builds a table with a 'Precinct' column and one column per candidate (contest[0].ca) filled from vm.pv.v[key]: per-precinct candidate votes. Live precinct view rule applies; confidence capped at med.

2026_runoff.fact: Wayback capture of app.harrisvotes.com/ElectionResults/DemocraticPrimary at 2026-05-26 20:47:41 CDT: same 'Precinct Reporting' tabs, "'/dem-pv-' + contestId + '.json?nocache=' + cacheTime" alongside "'/dem-resultsbyballot.json?nocache=' + cacheTime", and the RenderPrecinctVoting per-candidate precinct table (angular.forEach(vm.pv.v[key] ...)). Live precinct view rule applies.

rationale: Primary and runoff LIVE by check 3 (archived election-night live results app has a per-precinct candidate votes view fed by the same refreshing data feed as the totals); 2024 undetermined. LIVE_PRECINCT, confidence capped at med by the live precinct view rule.
